ac5_waiver.criterion: <html lang> updates when the language is switched (VCST-5602 AC5 / VCST-5617 runtime AC)
ac5_waiver.decision: Accepted on waiver — QA lead decision, 2026-08-06
ac5_waiver.why_not_provable: The Language submenu offers exactly one item (English), so an en->de transition cannot be observed. setLocale clamps unknown locales (availableLocales.includes(d) ? d : 'en'), so even a forced setLocale('de') would write lang='en' — no programmatic shortcut yields a trustworthy pass.
evidence_accepted: Source at main: language-service.ts:69 sets document.documentElement.setAttribute('lang', resolvedLocale) inside setLocale, guarded only by typeof document !== 'undefined' (SSR safety).
Same code confirmed present in the DEPLOYED bundle (setAttribute("lang" in vc-shell-vendors64804.js).

Real-UI-click probe: <html lang> scrambled to sentinel 'zz-SENTINEL', the genuine English menu item clicked, attribute rewritten to 'en' — the menu handler reaches the lang-syncing path with no app-side code.
ac5_waiver.residual_gap: Not proven that the written value DIFFERS per target locale. One-minute real-UI re-check once a second locale is registered.

corrected_prior_findings: The 08-04 comment on VCST-5598 stated auth on vcmp-dev is 'a Bearer token in localStorage, zero cookies'. WRONG — document.cookie is empty because the cookies are HttpOnly. The context holds .VirtoCommerce.Identity.Application (+2) and that cookie authenticates: invalid bearer + valid cookie => 200 on every call; invalid bearer + cookies cleared => 401 -> logout -> #/login. No client-side combination produces a 403 on this deployment, so the previously reported '403 + location:/Account/AccessDenied' is not client-reachable either.

The 08-04 comments on VCST-5602/5617 attributed the single-locale blocker to environment provisioning. WRONG — it is a product defect: the framework ships and merges de.json but the running app registers availableLocales: ['en'].

filed: VCST-5688 — [vc-shell] Session-expiry notification is buried under HTML parse-error toasts on a concurrent burst. Linked 'Relates' to VCST-5598. Local report: reports/bugs/open/BUG-vc-shell-session-expiry-toast-buried-by-parse-errors.md
recorded_not_filed: German shipped but unreachable in the Vendor Portal — framework/locales/index.ts exports de.json (22KB, fully translated per VCST-5635) and framework/index.ts:130 merges it, yet runtime availableLocales is ['en'] so the switcher renders one item. Suspected duplicate vue-i18n instance from the module-federation chunk split (globalProperties.$i18n is observably a second, EMPTY copy). vendor-portal src/locales/ holds only en.json and main.ts merges via app.config.globalProperties.$mergeLocaleMessage. THIS IS WHAT BLOCKS AC5 on 5602/5617. Recorded on both tickets per QA lead decision.

LOGIN_RE over-broad — it tests the whole pathname of any /api/ response, so the platform's own /api/platform/security/login matches; an authenticated 2xx from that path triggers sign-out (reproduced live). Harmless today only because isAuthenticated.value is false during sign-in. Cheap hardening: anchor the match, or restrict signal (a) to non-JSON. Recorded on VCST-5598.

Stranded 403 session — a 403-dead session leaves the user in an authenticated-looking shell over an empty list with only a generic banner, and a hard reload is byte-identical (never reaches #/login). Correct per VCST-5598's design (403 must not sign out) but there is no path back in. Recorded on VCST-5598.

Dashboard label truncation at 320px (pre-existing, unrelated to these tickets) — 2-column grid retained, labels ellipsise; the component self-reports '[VcDataTable] Column width crisis: sum(minPx)=1800px > availableWidth=778px'. Truncates in place with no h-scroll, so NOT a WCAG 1.4.10 failure.

untested: The NATURAL 302->HTML trigger for VCST-5598 — does not occur on this platform (a dead session answers 403; auth is cookie-borne). Untested, neither pass nor fail. AC1/AC2 were proven by fault injection: only the server reply was synthesized, the interceptor/latch/sign-out/routing/notification are the genuine deployed code.
Whether the isSessionExpired latch resets correctly on re-login within a single JS context (runs were separated by reloads to guarantee a clean latch).
An actual multi-touch pinch-zoom gesture (not performable via Playwright) — VCST-5602's zoom AC rests on the viewport meta plus the axe meta-viewport pass.
Screen-reader output was verified structurally (live-region text / aria attributes), never heard.

tracker_writes.note: Workflow required transition id 4 ('On QA' -> status Testing) before id 8 ('Finish test' -> Tested) became available. TESTED is the terminal state this command sets — never Done, never Cancelled. VCST-5602 and VCST-5617 were subsequently moved Tested -> Done by the QA lead (human), not by this run: changelog shows Testing->Tested 16:38:06 (this run) then Tested->Done 16:39:01 (human).
tracker_writes.lesson: When a ticket's status looks further along than the run intended, read the changelog before assuming the run overshot — a concurrent human edit is indistinguishable from your own write when the MCP authenticates as that same person. Here transition id 8 resolved to 'Tested' identically on all four tickets; the Done states were a human action 55s later.
